name: Grade 5 ELA assessments
blurb: Literary and informational reading items for Grade 5 reasoning and evidence.
examplePrompt: Create a Grade 5 literary reading item about a character choosing to help a friend, with an inference question and a question asking for supporting evidence.

name: Learnosity assessments
blurb: Create Learnosity assessments for a Learnosity Item Bank.
examplePrompt: Create a Learnosity ordering question: arrange these U.S. presidents by when they served, earliest first: John F. Kennedy, George Washington, Franklin D. Roosevelt, Abraham Lincoln. Correct order: Washington (1789–1797), Lincoln (1861–1865), Roosevelt (1933–1945), Kennedy (1961–1963).

name: Learnosity authoring integrations
blurb: Host-neutral recipes for embedding and configuring Learnosity authoring experiences.
examplePrompt: Plan a Learnosity item editor integration for teachers at school.example, using author ID teacher-1 and item reference fractions-1, with multiple-choice and cloze widgets.

name: Learnosity data integrations
blurb: Host-neutral recipes for supported Learnosity Item Bank and assessment data jobs.
examplePrompt: Plan a server-to-server job to read every item from a Learnosity Item Bank, including the paging rules and verification steps.

name: Spreadsheet calculators
blurb: Create interactive calculators with spreadsheet formulas, ready to embed on your website.
examplePrompt: Make a monthly budget calculator for my website using a spreadsheet. Start with monthly income of $4,000, rent of $1,500, food of $400, and transport of $200. Let visitors change these amounts. Automatically calculate total expenses and the remaining balance.

name: Quizzes & assessments
blurb: Create a question learners can answer and score in the browser.
examplePrompt: Make a multiple-choice question: Which process turns liquid water into water vapor? Options: evaporation, condensation, precipitation. Score evaporation as correct and explain each answer.

name: Flashcards
blurb: Make a study deck with cards to flip and review.
examplePrompt: Make a flashcard deck with these terms on the front and definitions on the back: evaporation — liquid turns to vapor; condensation — vapor turns to liquid; precipitation — water falls from clouds.

name: Survey responses
blurb: Record ranked choices or ratings for an existing survey. New survey authoring is not supported.
examplePrompt: Show the existing team-retro survey so I can record my priorities.

name: Concept maps
blurb: Show how ideas connect, or turn the map into a learning activity.
examplePrompt: Make a concept map with the water cycle at the center, connected to evaporation, condensation, and precipitation. Label each connection with a short explanation.

name: Interactive charts
blurb: Turn your data into interactive charts that visitors can explore. Embed them on your website.
examplePrompt: Make a bar chart of quarterly revenue: Q1 $120,000; Q2 $150,000; Q3 $170,000; Q4 $210,000. Title it Quarterly revenue and label the axes.

name: Fetch & shape data
blurb: Fetch public JSON or CSV and filter, group, join, or summarize it.
examplePrompt: Group these sales by region and sum revenue: West 120, East 80, West 60, East 90. Sort by total revenue, largest first.

name: FigJam boards
blurb: Plan a brainstorm or retro, then draw it with the Graffiticode FigJam plugin.
examplePrompt: Make a FigJam retrospective board with three sections: Went well, Could improve, and Next steps. Add three blank sticky notes under each section.
